name: daily_brief_later_v1
description: Brief Later (aegis-zmk): open seeds Stiwi has answered later (label stiwi-later). They stay visible; measured 0.69s.
scope: every open stiwi-later seed, up to 100; overflow is UNKNOWN
template: PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/> PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/> SELECT ?item ?id ?title ?priority ?status ?revision ?modified ?created WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { ?item schema:keywords "stiwi-later" ; seeds:status ?status ; seeds:priority ?priority . FILTER(?status != "closed" && ?status != "tombstone") OPTIONAL { ?item schema:identifier ?id } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:name ?title } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:version ?revision } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateModified ?modified } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateCreated ?created } } } ORDER BY ?priority ?id LIMIT 101
